The '''Kharidian Desert''' is an expansive region located south of the nations of [[Misthalin]] and [[Morytania]]. The desert becomes a dangerous region south of the [[Shantay Pass]], requiring a player to drink from [[waterskin]]s or other [[sources of water]] to avoid dehydration. The player will automatically drink every 90 seconds if they have a waterskin with charges in their inventory; the time between drinks can be extended by wearing [[heat-resistant gear]]. Failing to drink will cause the player to periodically lose [[hitpoints]]. Within the boundaries of towns, players are immune to the [[desert heat]] and do not need to drink.

Players may quickly travel to certain locations by using [[magic carpet]] rides, though some destinations are unavailable until certain quests have been completed.

This region also has its own [[Desert Diary|achievement diary]] that was released on [[5 March]] [[2015]], along with many other diaries.
